{
  "test_name": "Ledger_2297_Objection1",
  "test_code": "using System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection1\n{\n    private const string TestSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace TempProject\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class MyObject\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public MyEnum Value { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    public enum MyEnum\n    {\n        A,\n        B,\n        C,\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n    private const string ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttributeName = \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\";\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task EnumFormatter_OmitsExcludeFromCodeCoverage_ForNetStandard20AndNetFramework()\n    {\n        Assert.False(await HasExcludeFromCodeCoverageAsync(new[] { \"NETSTANDARD2_0\" }));\n        Assert.False(await HasExcludeFromCodeCoverageAsync(new[] { \"NETFRAMEWORK\" }));\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task EnumFormatter_IncludesExcludeFromCodeCoverage_ForNetStandard21Net60AndNet80()\n    {\n        Assert.True(await HasExcludeFromCodeCoverageAsync(new[] { \"NETSTANDARD2_1\" }));\n        Assert.True(await HasExcludeFromCodeCoverageAsync(new[] { \"NET6_0\" }));\n        Assert.True(await HasExcludeFromCodeCoverageAsync(new[] { \"NET8_0\" }));\n    }\n\n    private static async Task<bool> HasExcludeFromCodeCoverageAsync(string[] preprocessorSymbols)\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> frameworkRefs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        IEnumerable<MetadataReference> references = frameworkRefs.Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n\n        CSharpParseOptions parseOptions = new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest).WithPreprocessorSymbols(preprocessorSymbols);\n        SyntaxTree syntaxTree = CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(TestSource, parseOptions);\n\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { syntaxTree },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(\n            new[] { new MessagePack.SourceGenerator.MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator() },\n            parseOptions: parseOptions);\n\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation outputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        Assert.Empty(runResult.Diagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        foreach (GeneratorRunResult result in runResult.Results)\n        {\n            Assert.Null(result.Exception);\n        }\n\n        Assert.Empty(outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol formatterSymbol = Assert.Single(\n            outputCompilation.GetSymbolsWithName(\"MyEnumFormatter\", SymbolFilter.Type).OfType<INamedTypeSymbol>());\n\n        return formatterSymbol.GetAttributes().Any(\n            attr => attr.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttributeName);\n    }\n}\n"
}
